content.text: {"stops":[{"poi_id":"p3","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"The terraces ripple like green stairs carved by patient hands."},{"poi_id":"p5","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Holy springs where the water feels older than the stones."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p6","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"The palace courtyards are a quiet little pocket of royal history."},{"poi_id":"p9","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Haggle with a grin and leave with something that actually feels like Bali."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p2","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m2","note":"Clifftop temple with cheeky monkeys and a view that makes you forget your name."},{"poi_id":"p19","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"A proper plate of Balinese chicken rice, halal and full of local soul."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p4","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m3","note":"Monkeys, mossy temples, and more mischief than a gecko can gossip about."},{"poi_id":"p14","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"A breezy pit stop with drinks that taste like the jungle had a good idea."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p11","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m1","note":"Chase sunbeams into that hidden canyon waterfall, it feels like a secret the jungle kept for you."},{"poi_id":"p8","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Sink your toes into the sand and let the waves do the talking for a while."},{"poi_id":"p13","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Stick around after dark for the beats, the pool, and that easy Bali glow."}]}
Sunrise in Ubud, royalty and rice, then cliffs, falls and beach clubs — every must-do made it, terima kasih (thank you).
